card.name: Start of a word after an opening bracket
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word split into parts, often right after an opening parenthesis or a comma in drug label text. Examples are the start of anaphylactic, marrow, or a drug name.

modes.label: Word after parenthesis
modes.description: First piece of a clarifying word placed in brackets.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Early piece of a long drug or brand name.

modes.label: Start of repeated capitalized word
modes.description: First piece of an all-caps word or brand name.

card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a long or split word, such as a drug name or a term in brackets.
